change: For a singleton extraction request only, if both its initial response and the existing one retry end with finish_reason=length, permit one final request with the identical model, messages, temperature, and thinking setting but max_tokens increased from 8192 to 16384. Accept the first complete parseable response; no content-based choice among complete outputs is allowed.
rationale: The frozen singleton request produced no usable verdict because both permitted outputs ended exactly at the 8192-token ceiling. Extending only the output ceiling allows the same deterministic decoding task to terminate without dropping or guessing the user fragment.
unchanged: extractor model, prompt, input fragments, temperature, and thinking mode
controller and QA prompts, models, schemas, and paid no-retry protocol
